fields.text: Floor 1 (Gift of Peace): 2,000 coins, floor 2 (Grain of Plenty): 3,000, floor 3 (Box of Health): 5,000, floor 4 (Cradle of Life): Fighting boots or Fancy boots. Together that is 10,000 coins. Each chest opens once.

reward: 10,000 Coins (2,000 + 3,000 + 5,000), boots (Fancy boots or Fighting boots) and 4 emotes.

quickSteps: The fastest way: talk to Count Check in the Lumbridge graveyard, south of the church: Talk-to, "Where can I learn more about security?", "Yes". He teleports you for free straight to the entrance, but only once and only if you have never been to the Stronghold.

Without the teleport: a canoe at Woodcutting 12-26 takes you from Lumbridge only as far as Champions' Guild (1 stop), then walk north-west along the river, about 2 minutes. At Woodcutting 27 the canoe goes straight to Barbarian Village.
Find the hole (Entrance) in the middle of the village by the mine and climb down.
Turn on run (the boot icon by the minimap) and do not attack the monsters: run from door to door.

The doors come in pairs. Between them is an empty corridor where nobody hits you: eat and recover here. At the second door there is sometimes a security question: the right answer is always that you never share your password, PIN or codes and do not trust links in chat.
Floor 1 (Vault of War): at the end open Gift of Peace for 2,000 coins. Then take the ladder down.
Floor 2 (Catacomb of Famine): the monsters are aggressive here, so do not linger. At the end open Grain of Plenty for 3,000 coins.
Floor 3 (Pit of Pestilence): open the Box of Health for 5,000 coins and a full health restore.
Floor 4 (Sepulchre of Death): open the Cradle of Life and choose Fighting boots or Fancy boots.

The way out is the home teleport: Magic tab, Lumbridge Home Teleport (the first icon), and do not press anything for about 14 seconds. It is free, once every 30 minutes; if the icon is grey the teleport is recharging, so go back by the ladders (Climb-up).

title: Magic to 25 (Varrock Teleport)
how: After Imp Catcher (875 XP) and Witch's Potion (325) you have Magic 10 without a single spell. After that, cast combat strike spells on the cows in Lumbridge: a cow has 8 health and every one drops a hide, so the XP comes together with money. Spells of the same tier hit equally hard and equally accurately; they differ in XP and runes: Wind Strike (Magic 1) 5.5 XP, Water Strike (5) 7.5, Earth Strike (9) 9.5, Fire Strike (13) 11.5. The XP goes to both Magic and Hitpoints.

itemsRecommended.howToGet: Instead of an ordinary Staff: it replaces the fire runes for Fire Strike (3 runes per cast). In Zaff's Superior Staffs about 1,500 gp, about 940 gp on the Grand Exchange. It pays for itself: see the calculation below.
Earth Strike (Magic 9-12) uses 2 earth runes per cast. If you go straight to Fire Strike you do not need it.
Fire Strike (from Magic 13) uses 3 fire runes per cast, unless you have a Staff of fire.

For the teleports once you have the level: one Law rune with 3 Air runes and 1 Fire rune per Varrock Teleport (Magic 25), and again for Lumbridge (31) and Falador (37). Buy them at the Grand Exchange on your next stop in Varrock; they are not needed for training.
